# appmixer_flow (Data Source)

Reads an existing Appmixer flow by ID. Use this to reference a flow that was created outside of Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appmixer_flow" "onboarding" {
  flow_id = "flow-abc123"
}

output "onboarding_stage" {
  value = data.appmixer_flow.onboarding.stage
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `flow_id` (String) Server-assigned flow ID to look up.

### Read-Only

- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Arbitrary string metadata attached to the flow.
- `flow_json` (String) Flow descriptor as a canonical JSON string.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the flow.
- `stage` (String) Current execution stage: `running` or `stopped`.
